document.body:
Warehouse storage audit, Plant 3, April to June 2026
Audit of 6 and 7 July 2026 by the raw material team of CEAT.
All four bays of the raw material warehouse are covered and ventilated, and every bale of natural
rubber stood on a pallet. 1,180 of the 1,229 issue lines followed first in, first out. 11 of the 412 lots
in store were past the time-to-use limit of their grade. All 11 got the storage ageing check before
issue. 1 of them failed it and was downgraded.
What was checked and what was found
Area What was checked Finding
Warehouse
storage
Cover, ventilation, pallets,
distance from sun and heat
All four bays are covered and ventilated. Two pallet
positions in bay 4 get direct sun from a roof light after 3
pm. Both positions are now blocked.
FIFO storage The 1,229 issue lines of April to
June against the receipt dates
1,180 issue lines followed first in, first out, which is
96%. The other 49 were issues from the front pallet of a
double-deep row while an older lot stood behind it.
Time-to-use limit The receipt date of all 412 lots
against the limit of the grade
11 lots were past the limit. All 11 got the storage ageing
check before issue. 10 passed. 1 failed and was
downgraded.
Lot traceability The lot card against the bay, and
40 mixing batches against their
lots
Every lot card had the receipt date. 3 lot cards named a
location that did not match the bay. All 40 mixing
batches were traced back to their lot.
Contamination and
moisture control
Wrapping, foreign matter and
moisture at receipt
5 bales with torn wrapping were set aside and wrapped
again. No wet bale was found.
Grades kept apart Grades by bay and by row No row with two grades was found.
Actions
Action Owner Due
Fit a shade under the roof light of bay 4 and keep the two
pallet positions blocked until it is fitted
Warehouse lead 30 September 2026
Change the double-deep rows of bay 2 so that the older lot
stands in front
Warehouse lead 31 August 2026
Correct the 3 lot cards and add a location check to the weekly
stock count
Store supervisor 15 August 2026
Report every lot that passes its time-to-use limit to the store
lead on the same day
Store supervisor From 1 September
2026
Next audit
The next audit covers July to September 2026 and runs in the first week of October 2026. It counts the
issue lines of bay 2 again after the rows are changed.

Synthetic sample written for the RPG NeuralMesh demonstration. It is not a record of CEAT.
